_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 104 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: Anti-Vehicle Mine

description.text: An anti-vehicle mine that detonates when armored vehicles pass over it. Place on the ground to arm. Cannot be stacked or positioned too close together.

_unlock_note: Unlock recorded 2026-08-02 from Battlefield 6's own in-game unlock and challenge data. Not from the screenshot cited above: unlock text only displays in-game on items the account does not own.
